title: The Summer Rain Trip
segments: The summer of 2025 was coming! Mai, Linh (Mama), and Long (Ba) were so excited. They lived in Đồng Nai, Southern Vietnam, but planned a special trip. Their destination was Hòa Bình Village in Northern Vietnam, to visit Grandma. Mai couldn't wait to see her. They spent evenings talking about the long journey and fun family time.

After that, everyone kept talking about the exciting trip. But one evening, while watching TV, a news report came on. The weather forecast warned of 'mưa lớn' – very heavy rain – expected in Northern Vietnam, especially around Hòa Bình Village. Linh and Long looked at each other, worried. Mai felt a knot in her stomach.

Because of this, days later, the news confirmed their fears. Heavy rains caused severe floods and road closures across Northern Vietnam. The route to Hòa Bình Village was impassable. Linh and Long sadly decided they had to postpone their trip. Mai's excitement turned to deep disappointment. The summer trip was off.

Then, Mai felt very sad, missing her grandma and the fun trip. Seeing her disappointment, Mama Linh had an idea. "What if we have a special 'staycation' here at home?" she suggested. "We can explore our own nature, play games, and even video call Grandma in Hòa Bình to cheer you up!" Long liked the idea.

Because of Mama Linh's idea, the family started their 'staycation'. They explored local parks and a small forest near their home. After a few days, the heavy rain finally stopped! The sun shone brightly again. Mai felt much happier, laughing as they discovered new plants and tiny creatures. They video-called Grandma, promising to visit Hòa Bình later in the year.

After that, the family often remembered their 'staycation' with smiles. They learned that fun and nature were everywhere, even near their home in Đồng Nai. Mai still missed Grandma, but she knew they would visit Hòa Bình soon. Their summer trip wasn't what they planned, but it brought them closer, full of new memories.
endWrap: The family's unexpected summer taught them that happiness isn't always about grand plans but about finding joy together, wherever they are. Their bond grew stronger, ready for future adventures.
